answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 151305 Country: South Korea Title: Is it okay to arrange the function of Barat or reception of walimah during 10 Dull-al-Hajj days? Question: Kindly describe the significance of first 10 days of Dull-al-Hajj. Is it okay to arrange the function of Barat or reception of walimah in those days? Answer ID: 151305 Posted on: Feb 26, 2025 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 915/927/B=9/1438) (1) The first ten days of Dhul Hijjah carry lots of virtues. Allah has sworn by these ten nights in the Holy Quran. It is recorded in Hadith that praying during each night of these ten days is equal to worshiping in Shab-e-Qadr and fasting during each day of these ten days is equal to fasting of one year. And the rewards of good deeds are multiplied during these days. i.e. the value of good deeds increases during these ten days. (2) Walimah is sunnah provided it does not carry extravagance, publicity and fame. As far as the matter of prevalent barat is concerned then one should avoid it to possible extent. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
